0:
set -euo pipefail

TEMPLATED_OVERRIDE_CONTENTS="$$( \
  jq -n -f "$${OVERRIDE_FILE_PATH}" \
  --arg JACKET_API_KEY "$${JACKET_API_KEY}" \
  --arg OMDB_API_KEY "$${OMDB_API_KEY}"  \
  --arg WEB_PORT "$${WEB_PORT}" \
)"
if ! [ -f "$${CONFIG_FILE_PATH}" ]; then
  echo "Config file does not exist, creating from overrides"
  mkdir -p "$$(dirname "$${CONFIG_FILE_PATH}")"
  echo "$${TEMPLATED_OVERRIDE_CONTENTS}" > "$${CONFIG_FILE_PATH}"
  exit
fi

# Use jq to merge the existing config with the overrides
echo "Merging existing config with overrides"
MERGED_CONFIG="$$(jq -s '.[0] * .[1]' \
  <(cat "$${CONFIG_FILE_PATH}") \
  <(echo "$${TEMPLATED_OVERRIDE_CONTENTS}") \
)"

# This needs to be done separately to avoid truncating the file while it's being read
echo "$${MERGED_CONFIG}" > "$${CONFIG_FILE_PATH}"

{
  "Port": $$WEB_PORT,
  "LocalBindAddress": "127.0.0.1",
  "AllowExternal": true,
  "AllowCORS": false,
  "APIKey": $$JACKET_API_KEY,
  "AdminPassword": null,
  "UpdateDisabled": true,
  "UpdatePrerelease": false,
  "CacheEnabled": true,
  "CacheTtl": 2100,
  "CacheMaxResultsPerIndexer": 1000,
  "FlareSolverrMaxTimeout": 65000,
  "OmdbApiKey": $$OMDB_API_KEY,
  "ProxyType": -1
}

modules:
  xgs_pon:
    valid_status_codes: [200]
    http_client_config:
      tls_config:
        # Self-signed cert without a SAN, which Go cannot verify
        insecure_skip_verify: true
    metrics:
      - name: xgs_pon_ploam_state
        valuetype: gauge
        path: "{ .ploam_state }"
        help: PLOAM state; 51 (O5.1) is operational
      - name: xgs_pon_rx_power_dbm
        valuetype: gauge
        path: "{ .rx_power_dBm }"
        help: Received optical power; -Inf with no light
      - name: xgs_pon_tx_power_dbm
        valuetype: gauge
        path: "{ .tx_power_dBm }"
        help: Transmitted optical power
      - name: xgs_pon_tx_bias_milliamps
        valuetype: gauge
        path: "{ .tx_bias_mA }"
        help: Laser bias current
      - name: xgs_pon_module_voltage_volts
        valuetype: gauge
        path: "{ .module_voltage }"
        help: Module supply voltage
      - name: xgs_pon_optic_temperature_celsius
        valuetype: gauge
        path: "{ .optic_tempC }"
        help: Optic temperature
      # Separate names: two entries with one name register duplicate descriptors
      - name: xgs_pon_cpu1_temperature_celsius
        valuetype: gauge
        path: "{ .cpu1_tempC }"
        help: CPU thermal zone 0 temperature
      - name: xgs_pon_cpu2_temperature_celsius
        valuetype: gauge
        path: "{ .cpu2_tempC }"
        help: CPU thermal zone 1 temperature
